Two evaluation metrics we use are Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) and Accuracy (Acc.).
Since no OCR is perfect, we propose to use ANLS as our primary evaluation metric, so that minor answer mismatches stemming from OCR errors are not severely penalized.

For the heuristics and upper bounds we use a vocabulary 4, 341 answers which occur more than once in the train split.
